bootstrap_checks.scope: Independent stream,counts,gates,exact aggregate and interval calculations given36paired differences; source/prediction reconstruction checked separately.

conclusion_boundary: Both primary intervals cross zero. Core MSE modestly lower but MAE higher; specified year/event exclusions reverse the MSE contrast sign. No prospective,causal,consensus or trading-profit claim.
limits: Current maintained model history lacks independently authenticated original per-point delivery and immutability.
